scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/ui && npm run build -w @atlas/catalog && npm run build -w @atlas/compare && node scripts/prepare-comparison.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @atlas/ui && tsc -p apps/catalog/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/compare/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.pack: npm run build -w @atlas/ui && npm pack -w @atlas/ui --pack-destination artifacts
